Ai River (Dandong)
The
Ai River
(
traditional Chinese
:
璦河
;
simplified Chinese
:
瑷河
, also
traditional Chinese
:
愛河
;
simplified Chinese
:
爱河
; originally
traditional Chinese
:
靉河
;
simplified Chinese
:
叆河
and
Chinese
:
烏骨江
in the
Tang dynasty
) in
Dangdong
,
Liaoning
,
China
, is the largest
tributary
on the right (Chinese) side of the
Yalu River
that flows between China and
North Korea
. It starts in the mountains of
Kuandian Manchu Autonomous County
, runs
182 kilometers (113
mi)
through
Fengcheng City
and
Zhen'an District
, and empties into the Yalu River at
Jiulianshan
, just south of the
Hushan Great Wall
.
